user.title: Tarif kWh
user.description: Pick your contract's option and power. Prices come from raphaelh.github.io/tarif-kwh (unofficial project).

tempo.title: Tempo day colour
tempo.description: For the "Current price" sensor. Tempo off-peak hours (22:00-06:00) are already known.

data_description.couleur_tempo: States bleu/blanc/rouge or blue/white/red. Without it, there is no "Current price" sensor.

data.pointe_ejp: Entity telling whether today is an EJP peak day (optional)

data_description.pointe_ejp: States on/off, or pointe/normal. Without it, the "normal" price is always used.

data.heures_creuses: Off-peak hours of your meter, e.g. 22:00-06:00 (optional)

data_description.heures_creuses: They are on your bill. Several ranges allowed, comma separated. Without them, there is no "Current price" sensor.

error.puissance_invalide: This power does not exist for this option.

abort.already_configured: The contract is already configured: change it from "Configure".
abort.single_instance_allowed: The contract is already configured: change it from "Configure".

donnees_anciennes.title: kWh prices may be out of date
donnees_anciennes.description: The price source ({url}) has not been checked since {date} ({jours} days). The sensors keep the prices from the last read: they are wrong if tariffs changed since then (usually on 1 February and 1 August). This alert clears itself once the source is up to date again.

publication_bloquee.title: Price publication blocked ({option})
publication_bloquee.description: The price source blocked publication of the "{option}" option: a new tariff did not pass its checks. The sensors keep the last validated tariff, which may no longer apply. Details in {url}. This alert clears itself once publication resumes.
